description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_GoodsShipping"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/goods-shipping">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingInvitation" name="Shipping invitation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingOffer" name="Shipping offer"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_GoodsShipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shipping" name="Shipping department" processRef="Process_GoodsShipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticCompany" name="Logistic company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" sourceRef="SendTask_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticCompany" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveOffers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_GoodsShipping" name="Goods shipping" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_GoodsToShip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipper</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Size_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_InviteCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ReceiveTask_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPostShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Shipping_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Parallel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsDepartmentHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Insurance_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeParcelInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Insurance_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouseman" name="Warehouseman">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Ready_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" name="Goods shall be shipped"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify who will do the shipping"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Size_Split" name="Large amount?"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Select one logistic company"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPostShipment" name="Use normal post shipment"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Shipping_Join" name="Shipping method determined"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split" name="Start shipping preparation"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance_Split" name="Insurance necessary?" default="Flow_InsuranceNotNecessary"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance_Join" name="Insurance decision done"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Join" name="Shipping preparation complete"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToClarify" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipper"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarifyToSizeSplit" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gateway_Size_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Size_Split" targetRef="SendTask_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${largeAmount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Size_Split" targetRef="Task_NormalPostShipment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!largeAmount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToReceiveOffers" sourceRef="SendTask_InviteCompanies" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersToSelect" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToParallelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackageLabel" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToInsuranceSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackageGoods" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNecessary" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${insuranceNecessary}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNotNecessary" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceJoinToReady" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToReady" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToReady" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToPrepare" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
